title: v0.32.10
description: What's Changed Models that don't set a repeat_penalty now default to 1.0 (off) instead of 1.1, matching other engines and speeding up speculative decoding; set a per-model parameter if an older model repeats itself. Faster prefill on NVFP4 MLX models with a global scale, about 7–8% on Qwen3.6 and Muse Glimmer. Fixed blob verification being skipped when an OCI manifest's config and layer share a digest. New Contributors @vigneshakaviki made their first contribution in #15504 Full Changelog : v0.3
